highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 bumps to Skia milestone m151 and ports more color math to managed C#.
highlights_body: Continues the v4 performance push by moving SKColor/SKColorF and premultiply conversions into managed code, adds Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM libraries, and fixes a native resource leak in encoded image decoding.

bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine to milestone m151, plus several follow-up chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs.

bullets.lead: Fixed a native resource leak decoding images
bullets.detail: SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) no longer leaks a native resource on every call.
Re-enables SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to fix a CPU raster regression introduced upstream.

bullets.lead: More color math ported to managed C#
bullets.detail: SKColor to SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run as managed integer math instead of round-tripping through native calls, reducing P/Invoke overhead.

bullets.lead: Reduced allocations in text shaping paths
bullets.detail: HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) is now allocation-free via pooled UTF-8 encoding, and per-call char[4] allocations were removed from HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and SKFourByteTag.Parse; SKShaper glyph results are now read via zero-copy spans.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11 WASM builds, and a preview-.NET WASM test job to catch exception-handling regressions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bumped the skia submodule to drop the SK_BUILD_FOR_WASM redefinition, added the cross-backend golden-image test harness, and added the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Opened the 4.151.0 line with the Skia m151 milestone bump and initial WASM/skia-sync follow-ups.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Ported SKColor/SKColorF conversion and SKPMColor premultiply math to managed C#, removed several hot-path allocations in HarfBuzzSharp and SKFourByteTag, and added the cross-backend golden-image test harness.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: Fixed the SKImage.FromEncodedData native resource leak, restored the CPU raster shader regression, and added the Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries ahead of the stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: Removes a per-call char[4] allocation in HarfBuzzSharp.Tag.Parse and adds Emscripten 5.0.6 WASM static libraries for the HarfBuzz binding.
